classification.difficultyReason: Explain that the collected variable is station preference and that station numbers identify categories rather than measure that preference.

content.prompt: Mr Ding is quite fond of the FM radio station 101.7. He decides to collect data on the favourite radio station of the other teachers. He says: “I am collecting numerical data, since radio stations are numbers.” Explain why he is incorrect.

answer.short: Categorical nominal — station numbers identify favourite stations.
answer.worked: The response is a favourite station, not a measurement. Station numbers act as labels, so these data are categorical nominal.
